episodeTitle.en: Building product at Stripe: craft, metrics, and customer obsession | Jeff Weinstein (Product lead)
episodeTitle.zh: 在Stripe构建产品：工艺、指标和以客户为中心 | 杰夫·温斯坦（Jeff Weinstein，产品负责人）

guestBioOfficial.en: Jeff Weinstein is a product lead at Stripe, where he helped grow their payment APIs to hundreds of billions in volume and transformed the way founders start companies into a few simple clicks with Atlas. Prior to Stripe, Jeff led several startups and sold companies to Groupon and Box. He’s known for his customer obsession, craft, quality, and building beloved products businesses rely on. In our conversation, we discuss: • The power of customer obsession and how to operationalize it in the product development process
guestBioOfficial.zh: 杰夫·温斯坦是Stripe的产品负责人，曾帮助将其支付API的交易量提升至数千亿美元，并通过Atlas将创始人创办公司的流程简化至几次点击。在加入Stripe之前，杰夫领导了多家初创公司，并将公司出售给Groupon和Box。他以对客户的执着、工艺、质量以及打造深受用户喜爱的产品而闻名。在我们的对话中，我们讨论了： • 客户执着的力量以及如何在产品开发过程中将其付诸实践

title.en: Building product at Stripe: craft, metrics, and customer obsession | Jeff Weinstein (Product lead)
title.zh: 在Stripe构建产品：工艺、指标和以客户为中心 | 杰夫·温斯坦（Jeff Weinstein，产品负责人）

summary.en: Jeff breaks down the skills behind his remarkably effective product leadership: a go-go optimism and long-term compounding philosophy, operationalizing product craft and quality, and treating every customer complaint as an 'unbelievable gift' of direct signal. He shares the 'Stripe Study Groups' empathy practice he started (role-play as a customer with no agenda to solve problems), how to talk to customers, how to know you have product-market fit, and how to pick great metrics. The episode is the longest in Lenny's history for good reason—a full archaeology of a beloved product leader's craft.
summary.zh: Jeff 拆解了他极高效率的产品领导力背后的技能：积极进取的乐观主义与长期复利式的理念、把产品工艺与质量落到日常，以及把每条客户抱怨都当作直连信号的“不可思议的礼物”。他分享了发起的“Stripe 学习小组”共情练习（角色扮演成客户、不以解决问题为目的）、如何与客户交谈、如何判断你已找到产品市场契合，以及如何挑选好指标。这期节目成为 Lenny 史上最长的一期并非没有原因——它是对一位备受喜爱的产品领导者“手艺”的完整考古。
